arm_definitions_and_event_parity.principle: Identical chronological events isolate adaptive-state and query effects.

chronology_and_visibility_receipts.principle: No future label can influence a current decision.

continuous_self_learning_ready_score.principle: EMIT BARE scalar; only 1.0 permits Exp5859.

continuous_self_learning_task.principle: Must be true and identifies the milestone's FR-11 experiment.

duration_s.principle: Measured wall time exposes bootstrap-only learning.

field_provenance.principle: Every metric and state edit traces to events, queries, validators, and hashes.

forward_transfer_recurrence_and_retentio.principle: New learning cannot hide forgetting or failed recovery.

frozen_protocol_and_query_budgets.principle: Science-time policy and budget changes are forbidden.

hard_case_and_family_lower_bounds.principle: Negative transfer on hard cases or one family blocks readiness.

honest_verdict.principle: A terminal prefix states ready, null, unsafe, retired, or blocked outcome.

inference_substrate.principle: `deterministic_exact_verifier_and_replay_no_llm` declares external-state learning without model inference.

no_model_weight_mutation.principle: Must be true; immutable GGUF weights are a hard boundary.

null_and_ablation_controls.principle: Random, never, always, shuffled, reset, and feature ablations test causality.

preconditions_checked.principle: Gates, hashes, counts, budgets, validators, splits, seeds, resources, and outputs prevent invalid learning.

prospective_and_query_efficiency_metrics.principle: Learning value and exact feedback cost are jointly measured.

query_selection_and_rejected_buffer_rece.principle: Sparse feedback and failed edits remain auditable.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A checksum detects event, budget, selector, seed, or state drift.

retirement_decision.principle: Same blocked/no-lift outcome closes the reduced-oracle scope.

rollback_restart_and_state_hashes.principle: Versioned state must restore and resume exactly.

row_file_receipt.principle: Path, row count, and hash expose all prospective decisions.

status.principle: A terminal A/B state distinguishes self-learning evidence from a partial stream.

test_commands.principle: Commands document gates, visibility, arms, metrics, controls, state, and safety.

test_exit_codes.principle: Exit codes prevent unsafe or incomplete learning becoming readiness.

upstream_hashes_and_gate_receipts.principle: Only clean lifecycle and replay evidence may enter.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: True records exact labels and promotion authority.

versioned_consolidation_and_promotion.principle: Only held-out exact validation can promote external memory.

selector_policy.decision_rule: query first addition event for each unseen structural signature

duplicate_group.reason: duplicate-group weighting is reported but cannot promote

memory_reset.reason: reset external memory loses forward transfer

never_query.reason: frozen/no-query arm has no exact-feedback learning

query_order_permutation.reason: permuted sparse feedback cannot claim chronological causality

random_query.reason: matched random feedback is lower than reduced selector

selector_feature_ablation.reason: removing structural signature destroys acquisition recall

shuffled_label_rejection.reason: shuffled exact answers remain buffered and unpromoted
